key_points: Piper Sandler cut price target to $125 citing growth concerns, triggering a 4.5–6% sell-off across multiple sessions
CSCO is significantly underperforming networking peers (Arista, Ciena flat) and the broader tech sector, indicating company-specific rather than sector-wide weakness
Insider selling and profit-taking are compounding downward pressure on shares
Quantum networking collaboration with Infleqtion is strategically interesting but too nascent to serve as a near-term catalyst
Valuation debate persists — some sources argue CSCO remains overvalued even after the drop, while others see value in AI networking ambitions
